How to import data into R from different sources, including local files and online databases.
You will learn to not use local data files, but instead read the data from an online Google Sheets database

# 01 Setup your environment

Run the common setup script and synchronize the local project with
GitHub.

```{r}
# Run the setup script containing package restoration, helper functions, etc.
source(here::here("scripts", "01-setup.R"))

# Pull changes from the online repository into this local project folder.
# This is especially important when collaborating on the same project.
system2("git",c("-C", here::here(), "pull"))

# authenticate your @student.rug.nl google account
gsheets_auth()
```


# 02 Method 3 - read data from  online databases

This is the highly recommended choice of these three methods.
This means that there is only one version of
the data, and all collaborators read the same data. This is therefore
preferred method for collaborative projects, especially when the data change
 over time. The all team members always work with the up-to-date data.

# Answering questions:
1.  How many individuals, tags and deployments are there, and over which period? Which age classes?
2.  What is the sampling schedule (intervals between fixes)? Does it change over time or between tags? To which interval will you resample?
3.  Which quality information is available (satellites, HDOP, Movebank outlier flags), and how many fixes does each filter remove?
4.  Which speed threshold is realistic for your species?
5.  Which environmental data do you need, at which resolution, and in which projection?

```{r} 
#1
#| label: data-overview
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Drop geometry for faster summaries
tracks_df <- st_drop_geometry(tracks)
meta_df   <- st_drop_geometry(meta)

# Deployments that actually have location data
meta_used <- meta_df |>
  semi_join(tracks_df, by = "deployment_id")

# 1. Individuals, tags and deployments
n_overview <- tibble(
  n_individuals = n_distinct(meta_used$individual_id),
  n_tags        = n_distinct(meta_used$tag_id),
  n_deployments = n_distinct(meta_used$deployment_id)
)
n_overview

# Same counts for the full metadata (incl. deployments without tracks)
meta_df |>
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n_distinct(individual_id),
    n_tags        = n_distinct(tag_id),
    n_deployments = n_distinct(deployment_id)
  )

# 2. Period covered
# a) by the tracking data
tracks_df |>
  summarise(
    first_fix  = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_fix   = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    span_years = as.numeric(difftime(last_fix, first_fix, units = "days")) / 365.25
  )

# b) by the deployment on/off dates
meta_used |>
  summarise(
    first_deploy_on = min(deploy_on_timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_deploy_on  = max(deploy_on_timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_deploy_off = max(deploy_off_timestamp, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Number of deployments per year (start year)
meta_used |>
  count(year = year(deploy_on_timestamp), name = "n_deployments") |>
  print(n = Inf)

# 3. Age classes
age_classes <- meta_used |>
  mutate(animal_life_stage = fct_na_value_to_level(animal_life_stage, "unknown")) |>
  group_by(animal_life_stage) |>
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n_distinct(individual_id),
    n_deployments = n_distinct(deployment_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_deployments))
age_classes
```
```{r}
#| label: sampling-schedule
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

tracks_df <- st_drop_geometry(tracks)
meta_df   <- st_drop_geometry(meta)

# Fix intervals within deployment and sensor type
fixes <- tracks_df |>
  select(deployment_id, sensor_type_id, timestamp) |>
  distinct() |>                                   # drop duplicated fixes
  left_join(
    meta_df |> select(deployment_id, tag_id, individual_id, animal_life_stage),
    by = "deployment_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(deployment_id, sensor_type_id, timestamp) |>
  group_by(deployment_id, sensor_type_id) |>
  mutate(dt_h = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, lag(timestamp), units = "hours"))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(year = year(timestamp))

# Which sensors are present?
count(fixes, sensor_type_id)

# 1. Overall distribution of intervals (hours)
fixes |>
  filter(!is.na(dt_h)) |>
  group_by(sensor_type_id) |>
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    p05    = quantile(dt_h, 0.05),
    q25    = quantile(dt_h, 0.25),
    median = median(dt_h),
    q75    = quantile(dt_h, 0.75),
    p95    = quantile(dt_h, 0.95),
    max    = max(dt_h)
  )

fixes |>
  filter(!is.na(dt_h), dt_h > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(dt_h)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1/60, 0.25, 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 72, 240),
    labels = c("1 min", "15 min", "1 h", "3 h", "6 h", "12 h", "1 d", "3 d", "10 d")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sensor_type_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Interval between consecutive fixes", y = "Count")

# 2. Change over time: median interval and fixes per day, by year
fixes |>
  filter(!is.na(dt_h)) |>
  group_by(sensor_type_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    n_fixes     = n(),
    n_tags      = n_distinct(tag_id),
    median_dt_h = median(dt_h),
    q75_dt_h    = quantile(dt_h, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)

fixes |>
  filter(!is.na(dt_h), dt_h > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(year), dt_h)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ sensor_type_id, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Interval (h, log scale)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))

# 3. Between tags / deployments
per_deployment <- fixes |>
  filter(!is.na(dt_h)) |>
  group_by(deployment_id, tag_id, individual_id, animal_life_stage, sensor_type_id) |>
  summarise(
    start       = min(timestamp),
    end         = max(timestamp),
    n_fixes     = n() + 1,
    median_dt_h = median(dt_h),
    q75_dt_h    = quantile(dt_h, 0.75),
    fixes_per_day = n_fixes / as.numeric(difftime(end, start, units = "days")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

per_deployment |>
  ggplot(aes(start, median_dt_h, colour = factor(sensor_type_id))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Deployment start", y = "Median interval (h)", colour = "Sensor")

summary(per_deployment$median_dt_h)

# 4. Which resampling interval? Test a few candidates.
# For each deployment and candidate interval: the share of time bins
# (between first and last fix) that contain at least one fix.
candidates_h <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, 24)

coverage <- map_dfr(candidates_h, function(h) {
  fixes |>
    group_by(deployment_id) |>
    mutate(bin = floor_date(timestamp, unit = paste(h, "hours"))) |>
    summarise(
      n_bins_total = as.numeric(difftime(max(bin), min(bin), units = "hours")) / h + 1,
      n_bins_with_fix = n_distinct(bin),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(interval_h = h, coverage = n_bins_with_fix / n_bins_total)
})

coverage |>
  group_by(interval_h) |>
  summarise(
    median_coverage   = median(coverage),
    deployments_ge_80 = sum(coverage >= 0.8),
    deployments_ge_50 = sum(coverage >= 0.5),
    n_deployments     = n(),
    n_fixes_retained  = sum(n_bins_with_fix)
  )
```
# where did the birds start their journey?

```{r}
#| label: dataclear
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(dbscan)
library(maps)          # world.cities, used to name clusters

# ---- Settings ---------------------------------------------------------
eps_km <- 50           # points closer than this are one tagging site/cluster

# ---- 1. Tagging coordinates per deployment ----------------------------
# Empty points become NA instead of failing
xy_from_sfc <- function(x) {
  empty <- st_is_empty(x)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(x), ncol = 2)
  if (any(!empty)) out[!empty, ] <- st_coordinates(x[!empty])[, 1:2]
  out
}
ok <- function(x, y) !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & !(x == 0 & y == 0)

on_xy  <- xy_from_sfc(meta$deploy_on_location)
cap_xy <- xy_from_sfc(meta$capture_location)

# ---- 2. Clean tracks --------------------------------------------------
tracks_clean <- tracks |>
  select(deployment_id, sensor_type_id, timestamp, long, lat,
         argos_lc, ground_speed, heading,
         algorithm_marked_outlier, manually_marked_outlier) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(timestamp)) |>
  filter(is.na(algorithm_marked_outlier) | !algorithm_marked_outlier) |>
  filter(is.na(manually_marked_outlier)  | !manually_marked_outlier) |>
  distinct(deployment_id, sensor_type_id, timestamp, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(deployment_id, timestamp) |>
  mutate(sensor = if_else(sensor_type_id == 653, "gps", "argos")) |>
  select(-algorithm_marked_outlier, -manually_marked_outlier)

# First fix per deployment (fallback for the tagging location)
first_fix <- tracks_clean |>
  group_by(deployment_id) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(deployment_id, fix_lon = long, fix_lat = lat)

# ---- 3. Tagging site per deployment, with source ----------------------
tag_sites <- tibble(
  deployment_id = meta$deployment_id,
  on_lon  = on_xy[, 1],  on_lat  = on_xy[, 2],
  cap_lon = cap_xy[, 1], cap_lat = cap_xy[, 2]
) |>
  left_join(first_fix, by = "deployment_id") |>
  mutate(
    loc_source = case_when(
      ok(on_lon,  on_lat)  ~ "deploy_on_location",
      ok(cap_lon, cap_lat) ~ "capture_location",
      ok(fix_lon, fix_lat) ~ "first_fix"
    ),
    tag_lon = case_when(loc_source == "deploy_on_location" ~ on_lon,
                        loc_source == "capture_location"   ~ cap_lon,
                        loc_source == "first_fix"          ~ fix_lon),
    tag_lat = case_when(loc_source == "deploy_on_location" ~ on_lat,
                        loc_source == "capture_location"   ~ cap_lat,
                        loc_source == "first_fix"          ~ fix_lat)
  ) |>
  select(deployment_id, loc_source, tag_lon, tag_lat)

count(tag_sites, loc_source)   # how many deployments use which source

# ---- 4. Origin: country, or country - city if several clusters --------
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  select(country = name_long)

sites_sf <- tag_sites |>
  filter(!is.na(tag_lon)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("tag_lon", "tag_lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Cluster tagging sites (great-circle distances, single-linkage DBSCAN)
d  <- matrix(as.numeric(st_distance(sites_sf)), nrow = nrow(sites_sf))
cl <- dbscan(as.dist(d), eps = eps_km * 1000, minPts = 1)$cluster

clusters <- sites_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(cluster = cl) |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(n_deployments = n(),
            clon = mean(tag_lon), clat = mean(tag_lat),
            .groups = "drop")

cent <- st_as_sf(clusters, coords = c("clon", "clat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Country of each cluster centre
clusters$country <- world$country[st_nearest_feature(cent, world)]

# Nearest city (pop >= 10 000) to each cluster centre, used as the name
cities <- maps::world.cities |>
  filter(pop >= 10000) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)
clusters$city <- cities$name[st_nearest_feature(cent, cities)]

# One cluster in a country -> country; several -> "country - city"
clusters <- clusters |>
  group_by(country) |>
  mutate(origin = if (n() == 1) country else paste0(country, " - ", city)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(origin = make.unique(origin, sep = " #"))

clusters |> arrange(country, desc(n_deployments))   # inspect

tag_sites <- tag_sites |>
  left_join(
    sites_sf |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      mutate(cluster = cl) |>
      left_join(select(clusters, cluster, country, city, origin), by = "cluster") |>
      select(deployment_id, cluster, country, city, origin),
    by = "deployment_id"
  )

# ---- 5. Metadata ------------------------------------------------------
meta_df <- meta |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(deployment_id, tag_id, individual_id, ring_id, sex,
         animal_life_stage, study_site,
         deploy_on_timestamp, deploy_off_timestamp) |>
  mutate(age_class = case_when(
    animal_life_stage %in% c("juv", "juv (1st winter)") ~ "juvenile",
    is.na(animal_life_stage)                            ~ "unknown",
    TRUE ~ as.character(animal_life_stage)
  )) |>
  select(-animal_life_stage)

# ---- 6. dataclear -----------------------------------------------------
dataclear <- tracks_clean |>
  inner_join(meta_df,  by = "deployment_id") |>
  left_join(tag_sites, by = "deployment_id") |>
  filter(is.na(deploy_on_timestamp) | timestamp >= deploy_on_timestamp) |>
  arrange(individual_id, timestamp) |>
  select(individual_id, tag_id, deployment_id, ring_id, sex, age_class,
         origin, country, city, tag_lon, tag_lat, loc_source,
         timestamp, long, lat, sensor, argos_lc, ground_speed, heading,
         study_site, deploy_on_timestamp, deploy_off_timestamp)

# How many rows did the cleaning remove?
tibble(raw = nrow(tracks), after_cleaning = nrow(tracks_clean), dataclear = nrow(dataclear))

dataclear |> distinct(deployment_id, origin) |> count(origin, sort = TRUE)
```
```{r}
#| label: tagging-map
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
pad <- 3
bb  <- st_bbox(sites_sf)
xl  <- c(bb["xmin"] - pad, bb["xmax"] + pad)
yl  <- c(bb["ymin"] - pad, bb["ymax"] + pad)

sites_df <- filter(tag_sites, !is.na(tag_lon))

# Density of tagging locations
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  stat_density_2d_filled(
    data = sites_df, aes(tag_lon, tag_lat, fill = after_stat(level)),
    contour_var = "ndensity", alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_count(data = sites_df, aes(tag_lon, tag_lat), shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Relative density", direction = -1) +
  scale_size_area(name = "Deployments") +
  coord_sf(xlim = xl, ylim = yl, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Where were the birds tagged?")

# Same sites coloured by origin
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = sites_df, aes(tag_lon, tag_lat, colour = origin),
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_sf(xlim = xl, ylim = yl, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Origin")
```
